name: Duplicate Finder
what_it_does: Every 15 min pulls new and changed records, normalises keys (domain, legal name, LinkedIn ID, HubSpot ID, email), merges exact matches and scores near-matches 0–100. ≥95 merge; 80–95 to RevOps; <80 kept separate. Logs its reasoning

name: Parent Company Linker
what_it_does: Links each company to parent, subsidiaries, divisions; proposes divisions that buy separately (RevOps approves); sets the outreach lock at the top parent. Re-links on HQ change or M&A news. <80 → RevOps
schedule: on new account, HQ change or M&A news

name: Headquarters Finder
what_it_does: Finds the parent's HQ city, state, country; weighs sources; returns location, confidence, other candidates and evidence. <80 → RevOps picks

name: Headquarters Re-checker (monitor)
what_it_does: Nightly on companies with move or M&A news, quarterly on all. Any change → alert in the patch control tower, then a new Patch Suggester proposal
schedule: nightly on move or M&A news; quarterly on all

name: New Account Finder
what_it_does: Weekly closed-won lookalikes; daily checks 7 other sources (ecosystem lists, intent surges, web visitors, business units, champion job changes, event attendees, renewal windows). Drops fit <36, customers, open deals, partners, competitors, DNC. Suggests to RevOps, never adds. <70 not suggested

name: Fit Scorer
what_it_does: Scores fit out of 60 (up to 15 each: industry, size and complexity, core systems, AI and integration maturity); maps score + ICP V2 quadrant to best / medium / low fit. Floor 36 never moves. Re-scores on change and monthly. <70 → RevOps

name: Patch Suggester
what_it_does: Proposes a patch for each new account or HQ change: geography first, then industry, with confidence and reason. Never writes a Patch ID. <80 → RevOps decides from evidence
schedule: on new account or HQ change

name: Current Vendor Finder
what_it_does: Finds integration, automation and agent tools each best/medium-fit account uses, from vendor case studies, job posts, procurement notices. Weekly. <60 tagged [HYPOTHESIS]

name: Renewal Date Finder
what_it_does: Estimates renewal as 3 years from earliest evidence unless a later contract signal exists; raises a renewal signal 9 months before. <60 no signal

name: Battlecard Writer
what_it_does: Drafts battlecard changes per vendor: shortfalls, switch path, proof, objection answers. Product marketing approves each

name: Buying Signal Spotter
what_it_does: Watches continuously: web visits and intent, Bombora surges, Sales Navigator alerts, hiring and tech changes, job changes, leadership news, earnings calls, press, renewal signals, event sign-ups. Records company, type, date, source link, strength; verifies company match and date; scores confidence. Strong signals (champion job move, checked visit, new leader, renewal, event, several people engaging) go straight to the Play Picker. <70 logged, not scored. Signals fade over 30 days

name: Account Ranking (workflow)
what_it_does: Turns signals into a timing score (max 40) with the weights below. Monday 06:00 ranks each patch by fit + timing. Daily 07:00 tops up each patch's batch after fast-lane plays and sends it to Gate 1 with each account's top 3 signals. Applies the checked-visit rule

name: Weekly Slot Planner (workflow)
what_it_does: Monday after ranking: base 25 slots per patch; never more than eligible accounts ÷ 13; floor 15, cap 40; pace boost (up to +50%) only to patches behind on intro meetings whose diagnosis stops at Input or Engagement and whose AE has <6 intros booked in 7 days. Fast-lane plays use their own patch's slots; overflow takes spare capacity, then that patch's lowest-ranked accounts, never another patch's base. AE nominations (max 3/week) start inside their patch's slots. Logs every allocation

name: Holdout Picker (workflow)
what_it_does: After allocation, randomly holds back 10% of each patch's new medium/low-fit plays with a logged weekly seed. Checks treated vs held-out balance on fit and timing (standardised difference <0.1) or redraws. Flags held accounts in graph and HubSpot with a 90-day end date. Reports at 90 and 180 days

name: Gate 1 (human: pod BDR)
what_it_does: Batch lands in the BDR's to-do list at 07:00 with fit band, timing, top 3 signals, Patch ID, AE, last touch, slots left. Accept or reject by 10:00 with one reason (bad fit, active deal, wrong timing, already in conversation). A rejected slot refills from the same patch. Hard blocks: no Patch ID / AE / pod, on an AE hold, or held out
feeds: Company Facts Collector; Buying Team Mapper

name: Company Facts Collector
what_it_does: Reads the latest annual report and investor deck, last two earnings call transcripts, 12 months of press, current AI/IT/automation job posts. Extracts statements on AI, automation, integration, modernisation, cost, CX, risk. Each fact keeps exact quote, page or timestamp, date, link. Drops anything >12 months old (except the latest annual report). Facts without quote + link are rejected
below_threshold_goes_to: facts without quote and link rejected
schedule: Day 1; best fit every 30 days, others 90
feeds: Use Case Matcher; Case for Change Drafter

name: Use Case Matcher
what_it_does: Finds candidate VEP-CFC use cases for the industry and core systems; scores evidence; keeps the top 3 with two supporting facts (or one fact + the company's engagement with us); tags each with pattern and outcome. <70 shown only as a question, never a claim

name: Case for Change Drafter
what_it_does: Writes: business problem in the company's own words, impact (no dollar figures), why now (top signals), why UnifyApps (use case + their core systems), closest proof, main and backup angle, risks (e.g. vendor contract). Every sentence cites a fact or is tagged [HYPOTHESIS]. <70 → BDR reviews at Gate 2
feeds: Play Picker; Message Writer; Meeting Prep Writer

name: Past Contact Query (rule step)
what_it_does: Rules: VEP-CFC is the only source of use cases (UC-ID + Blueprint link + account evidence). Guesses are tagged [HYPOTHESIS] and reach prospects only as questions. Conflicting sources are shown side by side, never settled by the agent. Two rule steps also run here: a graph query pulling past contact (events, downloads, visits, calls, past deals, loss reasons), and an account tagger (vertical, Patch ID, size, systems, vendors, AI maturity, fit band, pattern, outcome).

name: Account Tagger (rule step)
what_it_does: Rules: VEP-CFC is the only source of use cases (UC-ID + Blueprint link + account evidence). Guesses are tagged [HYPOTHESIS] and reach prospects only as questions. Conflicting sources are shown side by side, never settled by the agent. Two rule steps also run here: a graph query pulling past contact (events, downloads, visits, calls, past deals, loss reasons), and an account tagger (vertical, Patch ID, size, systems, vendors, AI maturity, fit band, pattern, outcome).

name: Buying Team Mapper
what_it_does: Loads the industry's default titles plus BDR edits; searches people at the company and division; assigns role (economic buyer, champion, technical evaluator, business owner, gatekeeper); checks the champions library; picks 3 Tier 1, 3 Tier 2, 4 Tier 3, 2 backups; flags the economic buyer. Gatekeepers mapped, never contacted. Job-change alerts promote a backup; a title the BDR removes 3× in an industry drops from its defaults. <70 on a role → BDR checks at Gate 2
feeds: Person Notes Writer; Contact Finder; Intro Finder

name: Person Notes Writer
what_it_does: Four-line note per person: role, time in role, past companies, public talks and posts; what they own ([HYPOTHESIS] unless public); link to the matched use case; past touches; nearby event fit. Professional info only. Refresh every 90 days and on job change. <70 flagged at Gate 2
schedule: Day 1; every 90 days; on job change

name: Intro Finder
what_it_does: For Tier 1 at best-fit accounts: finds shared work history with customer execs, partners, employees and AEs; uses opt-in LinkedIn connection exports (monthly) plus partners, SIs, investors. Ranks: worked together > overlapped > friend of a friend. Drafts the intro request into the patch AE's to-do list and holds cold touches to that person 7 days. <60 not suggested

name: Contact Finder (workflow)
what_it_does: Sends each person to the Sprouts plugin → verified work email, plus phone for Tier 1 and engaged people. No verified email → LinkedIn only. Saves with source and verify date to graph and HubSpot; re-verifies emails older than 90 days before use

name: Do-Not-Contact List (workflow)
what_it_does: One suppression list (opt-outs, bounces, complaints, legal holds); copies it to HubSpot, Apollo and Sprouts every 15 min; screens every phone against federal and state DNC before any dialler; records consent per person; completes erasure across all tools within 30 days, keeping only a hashed code so the person is never re-added
feeds: Send Rules Check; HubSpot; Apollo; Sprouts

name: AE checkpoint (human: patch AE, best fit only)
what_it_does: Best-fit accounts reach the AE's to-do list on Day 1 with account view and buying team (~5/week/patch). Approve, adjust or disqualify by Day 2 12:00; else backup AE, then Geo leader, before Gate 2 closes

name: Play Picker
what_it_does: Matches the signal (or the 13-week cycle) to a play; sets people, channels, start days; spaces tiers so no two people at one account get email the same day; picks senders only from the account's patch and pod (AE for Tier 1 LinkedIn and AE notes, BDR for the rest, executive sponsor for C-level). Also receives fast-lane signals. <70 → BDR picks at Gate 2
schedule: Day 2; fast lane within the hour
feeds: Page Builder; Content Picker; Message Writer

name: Page Builder
what_it_does: Builds one Art of the Possible page per account: operations from public facts only, 2–3 workflows reimagined (before/after) for the matched use cases, proof, how UnifyApps connects their core systems, a patch event. Button books a 60-min session with the patch AE + solution consultant. Fills marketing's locked template; page is noindex, at a hard-to-guess URL, with a tracked link per prospect. <75 → marketing ops checks

name: Content Picker
what_it_does: Picks one Content Factory asset per asset touch, matched on role, industry, use case, pattern, outcome, VEP stage, Geo; skips assets >18 months old or retired; ranks by fit and positive-reply history for that role; never the same asset to two people at one account in a week; adds an event only while seats remain. <70 → no asset, use a sourced insight

name: Message Writer
what_it_does: Writes every email and LinkedIn message in the play. Starts from the Content Factory's best message for category → sub-sector → company → persona and must agree with all four; uses the assigned handbook voice; one sourced fact, the pain this person owns, the likeliest objection for their role. Names the patch AE as session host. Pod-inbox emails in the BDR's name; AE notes from the AE's mailbox, warm plays only. <70 flagged at Gate 2

name: Fact Checker (checker, other model family)
what_it_does: Traces every claim in drafts and pages: facts to a public source ≤12 months old, numbers to a source or the proof library, use cases to a UC-ID with account evidence. Blocks anything untraceable

name: Message Grader (checker, other model family)
what_it_does: Scores each draft 0–100 on the message rubric: teaches something, relevant to role and company, actionable, applies to their business, well written in the right voice, follows copy rules. <75 → one automatic rewrite and regrade; <75 again → a person decides at Gate 2. Rubric weights checked monthly against replies
below_threshold_goes_to: one rewrite, then a person at Gate 2

name: Send Rules Check (workflow)
what_it_does: Blocks any draft that fails: clean text (no empty fields, wrong names incl. the AE's); person still in role (checked within 7 days of first send); not on DNC, held out, a customer or open deal; parent outreach lock owned by this owner; Patch ID, AE, pod present and no AE hold; sender from the account's pod and under their daily limit across all pods; person not in another sequence; state send window, consent, legal footer

name: Gate 2 (human: pod BDR)
what_it_does: One screen per account: account view, buying team, page preview, every draft with grade, fact and rule results (~5% carry planted test errors that never send). BDR approves, edits, swaps a person or holds, by 17:00 Day 2

name: Outreach Launcher (workflow)
what_it_does: Puts each approved person into channels: email steps into an Apollo sequence on the assigned inbox, LinkedIn steps into the sender's Sprouts queue, calls as Apollo call tasks. Schedules in the prospect's local morning and state window, keeping tier spacing. Holds every inbox and LinkedIn sender at 70% of daily limit. Writes owner, Patch ID, BDR of record, sequence status, tasks, notes to HubSpot; sets the parent outreach lock. Every write keyed on person + play (no double enrolment)

name: Call Script Writer
what_it_does: For each call task (Tier 1 day 6, Hot Visit, anyone engaged): adapts the BDR's best script or builds one from top Gong calls; writes signal-tied opener, permission question, 3–5 discovery questions, top 3 objection answers, 20-second voicemail, follow-up email draft. Orders each BDR's call list by interest inside each patch's time-zone block. <70 → BDR approves the script

name: Follow-up Planner
what_it_does: Keeps the account one conversation once anyone responds: a referral becomes the lead thread; a Tier 1 objection pauses Tiers 2–3 and gives the AE an answer note; 2+ people engaging in 7 days switches to Committee Surge. Every rewrite goes back through Fact Checker and Message Grader. <70 → BDR decides

name: Inbox Health Checker
what_it_does: Weekly inbox-placement tests per active domain (Gmail, Outlook, Microsoft, Barracuda, Proofpoint); daily blacklist and Gmail reputation checks; reply rate by recipient provider; maintains the email-security-scanner list. Every alert to the BDR and GTM engineer

name: Email Domain Swapper (workflow)
what_it_does: Rests a domain the same day if placement <70% in two tests or it hits a major blacklist, and swaps in a warmed spare. Blocks a new BDR's first send until their domains pass. Previously blacklisted domains are retired
schedule: same day on a failed check

name: LinkedIn senders (human: AEs, BDR, exec sponsor)
what_it_does: LinkedIn bans third-party automation, so people send. Each opens their Sprouts queue (messages pre-written and checked), reviews and sends from their own account. AE ~20 requests/day for own patch. A restriction warning → stop and report; tower pauses that sender. Unsent AE messages move to the BDR at day end

name: Reply Sorter (checker)
what_it_does: Watches every pod inbox (Apollo) and LinkedIn reply (Sprouts); classifies into 9 types: positive, referral, not now (with date), objection, wrong person, out of office, unsubscribe, bounce, auto-reply. Stops all channels for that person in both tools and tells the Follow-up Planner. Handles mechanical types itself: OOO moves the next touch to the return date; unsubscribe to DNC within 15 min; bounce triggers re-check + backup person; "not now" to Content Handoff. <90 on unsubscribe → treated as unsubscribe; <80 on anything else → a person sorts it
below_threshold_goes_to: a person sorts it (unsubscribe under 90 treated as unsubscribe)
feeds: Reply Writer; Follow-up Planner; Do-Not-Contact List

name: Reply Writer
what_it_does: Drafts the answer from the thread, account view, objection list and the AE's booking link; puts it with confidence in the BDR's to-do list (and the AE's for positive replies at best-fit accounts). The person sends, edits, adds a booking link, hands to the AE, or snoozes, from one screen; it goes out from the original thread. Reminder at 90 min; Geo leader alerted at 2 business hours. <70 marked for full rewrite

name: Meeting Handoff and Deadlines (workflow)
what_it_does: On booking via the AE's link: creates the deal at Engage owned by the patch AE; picks up meetings booked elsewhere from the AE's Google Calendar within 15 min. Locks Patch ID, BDR of record, meeting source, factory-sourced, factory-influenced (a rejected meeting rebooked within 30 days keeps its source). Books the SC, triggers the prep pack, sends agenda and 24h/1h reminders, runs a 2-touch reschedule on no-show. Runs AE deadlines (below) and escalations

name: Meeting Prep Writer
what_it_does: Builds the pack for AE and SC: account view, buying team, thread, Case for Change draft, likely objections, AotP page, questions to confirm economic buyer and timeline. Delivered into the AE's AI Twin, which then tracks promises made on the call

name: Meeting Labeler (checker)
what_it_does: Reads transcript, attendees, economic-buyer flag; labels intro / New Buyer Meeting / doesn't count, quoting evidence. Doesn't count if <20 min, no Tier 1–2 attendee, a reschedule, or a second intro at the account within 90 days. Unrecorded meetings labelled from calendar attendees and AE notes and marked unrecorded. <80 → Geo leader checks

name: Deal Qualifier (checker)
what_it_does: After each New Buyer Meeting checks six requirements: fit 36+, a VEP-CFC pain, engaged champion, New Buyer Meeting held, timeline ≤12 months, scheduled mutual next step. Marks each met / partly / missing with transcript quotes; lists gaps with the question that closes each; drafts the recap; recommends Qualified only when all are met. Saves won/lost outcomes and reasons to the graph. <80 → recommended not qualified, with gaps

name: AE confirm (human)
what_it_does: AE confirms meeting label and stage within 2 business days; deal moves to Commit

name: Winning Message Finder
what_it_does: Weekly: promotes messages with 3+ positive replies into the Message Writer's examples for that role and industry; shares them with the Content Factory. <3 positives → not promoted
feeds: Message Writer (after Quality Grader and Friday review)

name: Scoring Tuner
what_it_does: Monthly: re-fits fit and signal weights to meetings and qualified opportunities, learning from Gate 1 rejections, AE-rejected meetings, disqualifications, win/loss reasons. Learns across all patches, reports per patch. Proposals only
feeds: Fit Scorer; Account Ranking (after Quality Grader and Friday review)

name: Objection Collector
what_it_does: Updates the objection list and buyer language from call transcripts. <70 → sales reviews
feeds: Follow-up Planner (after Quality Grader and Friday review)

name: A/B Tester
what_it_does: Small changes (subject, opener, asset): continuous tests on positive replies, ≥20% traffic per version, 4-week limit. Bold changes: fixed-size tests on people (5%→8% reply needs ~1,060 people per version). Never tests one-point lifts
feeds: Message Writer (after Quality Grader and Friday review)

name: Quality Grader (checker)
what_it_does: Holds every agent's rubric and test set; runs them on every prompt, model or weight change and blocks a release on any drop. Enforces checker-on-other-model. Computes each gate's rung weekly per pod and AE. Drafts a policy when the same exception is resolved the same way 3 times
schedule: on every prompt, model or weight change; weekly rungs

name: Agent Monitor
what_it_does: Weekly: compares each agent to its baseline on block/edit rate, factual errors, grades, confidence calibration; alerts the GTM engineer on any slip

name: Test Error Planter
what_it_does: Plants errors (e.g. wrong patch AE, sender from wrong pod) in ~5% of Gate 2 items, which never send; scores each reviewer's catch rate

name: Alarm and Escalation (workflow)
what_it_does: Every 15 min reads tower metrics; on a red line takes the listed action (pause, throttle, move slots, demote a gate, add a to-do item); escalates unfixed alarms patch → pod (2 business days) → Geo (5) → CRO. Logs before/after numbers. Safety actions are automatic; resuming or moving anyone's work needs a person

name: Content Handoff (workflow)
what_it_does: Monday: pushes accounts in play to LinkedIn ad audiences by patch geography for 8 weeks; passes unreached people to the Content Factory (ads and content only, never cold email); moves "not now" and engaged prospects to nurture until their date; sets marketing_influenced; sends asset, message and pattern results by patch weekly

name: Privacy and Consent (workflow)
what_it_does: Recording consent per state; DNC checks; state legal checklists (send window, consent, footer); erasure across every tool within 30 days; 12-month clean-up of people who never engaged
